description: Reviewable Zaraz contract for the Pink Binder landing and blog zones. This is not a Cloudflare dashboard export.

search.emitted_by: blog search field commits (GA4 site-search reporting)

filter.emitted_by: blog grid filter changes (dropdowns, card chips, catalog tag, clear)

button_click.emitted_by: delegated tracker on every <button>/<role=button> click; data-analytics-id and data-analytics-section attributes refine identity

click.emitted_by: delegated tracker on outbound link clicks (GA4 enhanced-measurement-compatible shape)

traffic_attribution.inbound_sources: Automatic pageview tracking carries referrer and utm_* parameters on page_location; GA4 session attribution reports acquisition per source without extra events.
traffic_attribution.enhanced_measurement: Zaraz replaces gtag.js, so GA4 enhanced measurement does not run client-side; outbound clicks (click) and site search (search) are emitted by the app instead.
